title: 貴方の夢を受け継いで

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright throws herself into training for the Satsuki Sho. However…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll pull ahead right from the start! Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh! Dober?! Ngh…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes, I won! I knew if I kept up the pace, I'd be able to block you from catching up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I ran with all my strength, yet it wasn't enough…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Why, Trainer?
choice_data_list: You're not used to making the race.
You're not used to making the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Making the race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A runner ought to know how to set and control the pace of the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Most race makers are front runners or pace chasers. They set the tempo from the start, creating an advantage for themselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's not an option for those who surge forward at the end. If they're not suited to the pace up front, they're in for a lot of trouble.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Mejiro Dober may be capable of setting the pace, Mejiro Bright is the model example of those who can't.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So, does that mean I should mimic Dober's technique?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For the most part, an Umamusume's running style is something they're born with. Trying something unfitting would be to ignore their natural strengths.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have to find a way to make Mejiro Bright stronger at what she does best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright'll be running in the Satsuki Sho at Nakayama, yes? The final stretch there is pretty short…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Her chances are dangerously slim if she continues running as is, especially if the pace doesn't suit her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's probably best to think of a specific counterstrategy. Unfortunately, I'm at a loss for suggestions.
choice_data_list: Let's invite a more strategic racer to coach us, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh? Did you say… coach?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A lot of strategy goes into knowing just when to time a spurt—even in disadvantaged circumstances. There are definitely runners with a knack for it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finding that kind of runner to coach Mejiro Bright and help her develop a strategy for Nakayama might be what we need.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The perfect timing… even when at a disadvantage…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pardon, Trainer. I have a request, if you don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'd like to learn from someone who's adapted to their weaknesses, rather than someone who's good at spurts outright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I don't believe learning tactics will result in me becoming tactical. I'd prefer help from someone who shares the same struggles as me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Someone who struggled like you… I see. I guess that makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I think you could learn a lot from an experienced Umamusume who runs the way you do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright's casual response turns out to be fairly logical.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So… an Umamusume who surges during the final stretch, has recognized skill, and also struggled during the Classics…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thanks for calling, Trainer! I'm totally pumped to coach Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: All right, time to get to it, Bright! Let's get swole!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Thank you for agreeing to help, Ryan. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright's eyes sparkle. She must be excited to be coached by her beloved Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Your ears open, Bright? When they say the last stretch is short, they're not just talking about distance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Not being aware of your position can slow your speed. And if you don't push yourself through the middle, you'll miss the moment to go for the lead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'll call over some friends and we can do a scrimmage! Sound good to you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Understood, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Don't turn so wide at the corners, Bright! You're better off putting your muscles into finding an opening on the inside!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… This is raaather difficult, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Got that right! But if you don't master it, you'll end up just like I did. I don't want you quitting before you've made it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yep! I got pounded into the dirt! I wasn't strong enough back then, so that was part of it too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I don't want you going through what I did, Bright. So don't let up your effort!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Understood!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I knew Mejiro Ryan would be the perfect coach. She speaks so frankly about her failure and experiences.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright, a Mejiro has never won the Satsuki Sho before. But…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Don't worry about that! Only worry about running well. At the end of it, make sure to leave everything on the track!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I will, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's right—this isn't just Bright's attempt at the Triple Crown, but another attempt on behalf of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This easygoing Umamusume carries the expectations of her family on her shoulders, yet she appears incredibly happy.
